summary: Retail inventory and billing system for Vmart with multi-store support, role-based access, barcode billing, AI-powered demand forecasting, and automated replenishment
architectural_notes: MongoDB for data persistence with collections: users, products, stores, sales, vendors, purchase_orders, stock_transfers
React frontend with Spring Boot or Node.js backend
AI features: demand forecasting, auto reorder calculation, sales prediction
Docker containerization with cloud hosting deployment
Real-time updates and cloud sync capabilities

new_feature_requests.summary: JWT-based authentication with role-based access control (Admin, Manager, Cashier)
Dashboard showing total sales, low stock alerts, top selling products, out of stock items, and monthly revenue graph
Inventory management with add/edit/delete products, barcode support, stock tracking by branch, and stock transfers
Billing system with barcode scanning, GST calculation, discount support, invoice printing, and auto stock deduction
Replenishment system with automatic reorder suggestions, vendor management, purchase orders, and delivery tracking
Analytics with daily/monthly sales reports, product performance analysis, slow moving detection, and AI demand forecasting
Notifications for low stock, stock shortage, reorder reminders via email and SMS
